SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.quantity, o.product_id, p.product_name, o.buyer_id, bu.nickname AS buyer_nickname, o.seller_id, su.nickname AS seller_nickname, o.status, o.total_amount, o.buyer_note, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN users bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN users su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
